summary: New box Preterit: example for sense 1 in Preterit (96/67)

data.turoyo: "E", — omər, — "gəzzax lu tešiġo l mən? Ono mqawlaǧno, kili miṯo!" Əmmo: "Imkan latla, gəzzi."
data.translation: Der Junge sagt: Wozu gehst du zum Waschen? Ich habe Kolik und bin halb tot. - Sie spricht: Es hilft nichts, ich muß gehen.

rationale: First unprefixed Detransitive Preterit context: human 1sg predicate beside kili miṯo, in contrast with inherited ko-forms.

summary: New box Preterit: example for sense 1 in Preterit (97/83)

data.turoyo: Hawyo i gamiye kar, i aṯto du ǧanono du dast bərayḏé mqawlǧo. Omər: “Aḥuno, waxt d gsaymo i gamiye ḥaraka, w gəmfayšat.”
data.translation: Als das Schiffklar zur Abfahrt war, erkrankte die Frau des Gärtners, seines Kameraden, an Kolik. Der Gärtner sprach: Jetzt wird gleich das Schiff abfahren, schiffe dich ein, sonst. bleibst du zurück! -

rationale: Female unprefixed Detransitive Preterit; explicit narrative onset and patient subject confirm the added box.

summary: Retain the editors’ stem I filing and mqawləǧ/miqawləǧ base forms for this four-consonant root; no active counterpart or new Q stem is inferred.
Detransitive is the entry’s sole paradigm. Its subjects are sufferers; these attestations do not imply an omitted external agent.

The inherited ko-Preterit describes a current or reported resulting illness. Unprefixed mqawlaǧno and mqawlǧo add first-person state and narrated female onset; onset and state are contextual readings within sense 1.
The distinction of the supplied base forms supports the unprefixed Preterit placement. The copular attachment on mqawlaǧno is retained, without treating no as an object.
Confirm mqawlǧo (97/83) as the Detransitive Preterit corresponding to the stated mqawləǧ base, rather than an Infectum or independent result predicate; no new meaning depends on the choice.
Human sufferers extend the inherited ox examples; disease state/onset remains one meaning, not separate human and animal senses.
